titles.title: Tent Door At Night

credit_line: University Art Museum, The University of New Mexico, Julius L. Rolshoven Fund and the Friends of Art [purchase, 1972] (72.157)
description: In this semiabstract, loosely painted watercolor, two sides of a dark blue tent droop downwards, revealing a triangle of light blue. A brown pole rises out of the dark green earth to support the tent.
